name: Priyanka Desai
about_me: I'm Priyanka, an angel investor in Ann Arbor. I founded and sold a telehealth scheduling company. I invest $25-50k in early healthtech and want deal flow from clinicians who are building.
goals: Make three healthtech angel investments this year

debriefs.text: Met Mira Joshi, CEO of Clearpath Meds, a medication adherence startup. They need a clinical pilot site before raising. I said I'd introduce her to a hospital contact.
Coffee with Ravi Menon, another Ann Arbor angel. He co-invests with me sometimes and said he's seen a nursing handoff app from an ICU nurse.
Carmen Diaz, a pediatric nurse practitioner, wants to start a telehealth service for rural families. She asked for advice on reimbursement.
Talked to Esther Wu, business development at Stryker. She scouts medtech startups and said Stryker's venture arm likes clinician founders.
Bethany Kowalski, ED nurse manager at Michigan Medicine, runs the clinical innovation pilot program and says it can host startup pilots.

card.headline: Angel investor, healthtech
card.about: Former telehealth founder writing early checks.
